surface: DashWare CSV schema and safe publication
description: Qt retains MP10 sparse original-order rows, GLOBAL_TimeMS priority, synthetic FMT header slot, wire-format scales and binary mode-prescan semantics. Two bounded raw passes plus final hash replace the whole-log plot/index parser, with pre-index schema checks and atomic confirmed QSaveFile output. CSV quoting and retained empty/colon-containing text cells deliberately fix reference text-path splitting/ERR-EV spill; exact decimal microseconds avoid extreme double rounding. Known ordinary EOF tails warn, malformed/conflicting schemas and selected binary A fail. Full242 tests, actual X11 workflow, real5809-row/36-column raw comparison and105MB/7million-row independent validation pass.
disposition: Keep source clocks, strict schema/path guards, explicit warnings and no post-commit cancellation claims. Mode names use a bundled snapshot rather than mutable downloaded MP10 metadata; exponent spelling can differ numerically harmlessly. Some permissive legacy logs are refused. Validate an actual DashWare consumer and native Windows/macOS before strict parity; see DATAFLASH_DASHWARE_CSV.md.

surface: DashWare input types output and progress dialogs
description: The existing Developer action opens named nonblocking input/type/output dialogs with MP10 default GPS;ATT;NTUN;CTUN;MODE;BAT and basename-dashware.csv, then a modeless cancellable worker. The output picker confirms overwrite, operation gates cover GPS/Split/vehicle work, and close/destruction request cancellation without keeping a widget in the worker. Real Tools X11 picker/cancellation/CSV-byte audits pass.
disposition: Retain offline availability, actual dialogs and truthful result/warning counts. Reference screenshot matching, long-path geometry, high-DPI and native Windows/macOS remain independent visual gates.

description: MP10 raw byte ranges can cut records, lose the division remainder, repeat range metadata and retain stale output tails; text input follows binary-length copies. Qt copies every complete ordinary BIN/text record once, balances by data bytes, prefixes FMT/FMTU/UNIT/MULT and uses actual .log output for text. Known ordinary EOF tails are omitted with type/byte warning; unknown framing or truncated metadata fail. Existing paths/symlinks are refused, all pieces staged and hashes checked before individual no-overwrite renames; late failure preserves/reports exact published paths. Full241 tests, actual X11 route, real seven-part BIN/pymavlink and105MB independent byte/order probes pass.
disposition: Retain complete records, bounded metadata/lines/pieces, strict schema and explicit EOF warnings. Cancellation applies through the final pre-publication gate, not during publication; do not claim group atomicity or delete published outputs as rollback. Parts do not clone PARM/VER/MODE and are not full-flight state snapshots. See DATAFLASH_LOG_SPLIT.md for limits and evidence.

description: The existing MP10-position button now opens named nonblocking file/count/default-Cancel confirmation dialogs and modeless progress, sharing the page gate with GPS extraction and vehicle actions. Count2..1000/default10 is retained. Counts, warnings and partial published paths extend MP10's short success text; the worker never captures its widget and close requests cancellation. Actual production X11 route passes.
disposition: Preserve the working offline workflow and truthful publication warning; detailed MP10 pixel matching, long-path geometry, high-DPI and native Windows/macOS remain separate gates.

description: Current Qt logs record accepted RX and successfully submitted typed TX using exact final MAVLink1/2 bytes and signatures. SETUP_SIGNING and raw writes are structurally excluded; protected unsigned radio remains diagnostic-only and unlogged. Session tokens fence callback file replacement; failed logging is retired before errors and never turns successful transport submission into failure. Production tests cover rejection, key exclusion, file replacement, real Linux write errors and GPS extraction round-trip.
disposition: Recording still starts through the heartbeat/enabled mechanism rather than MP10 physical connect; pre-start packets and older RX-only logs cannot be recovered. Queued UDP is not delivery proof, wall-clock timestamps are not monotonic, and QFile buffering/close is not a durability guarantee. Keep TLOG_RECORDING.md and conservative Anon Log drops authoritative; native platforms remain open.

description: MP10 writes directly and may leave a partial destination after failure. Qt streams the same all-sender data bytes but uses QSaveFile without direct fallback; malformed GPS lengths or observed cancellation fail without replacing old output. Same/canonical input-output aliases and output symlinks are refused, reader CRC skips/truncated tails are visible, empty streams remain valid results. Core/UI/full240 tests and X11 actual-picker byte comparison pass.
disposition: Retain atomic publication and explicit best-effort warnings. Do not silently clamp invalid lengths, repair RTCM, filter senders or claim signature authentication. Close requests cancellation; completion already inside commit may precede that request. Native platforms and visual parity remain separately open.

description: A singleton modeless Qt window groups vault, named keys, offline selection and guarded initial provisioning instead of MP10 sequential prompts. Default-Cancel named warning explains cleartext/all-channel/no-ACK risk. Wrapped status reserves actual text height, releases it when shorter and uses a scrollable body on small screens. Production-theme720x786/560x520 tests and real X11 persisted-pending reconnect pass.
disposition: Keep partial labels, no raw key display and persistent uncertainty even with authenticated packets. Reference pixel/layout matching, Windows/macOS and high-DPI checks remain; do not count missing rekey/disable/reconciliation as complete.

surface: MAVLink Signing transport and operator workflow
description: TOOLS/SETUP share async local vault and guarded initial provisioning: exact fresh-disarmed ArduPilot target, dedicated private route, pre-observer radio/signed-heartbeat refusal, default-Cancel consent, one signed SETUP_SIGNING and required fingerprint/unconfirmed marker persisted before any possible write. Use locally stays offline/noTX; failures never restore unsigned traffic. Qt5/audio build237/237 tests22.96s; actual X11 isolated SERIAL1 SITL provisioning and independent unsigned-request refusal/signed acceptance before and after fixture restart pass. TLOG has27090 valid frames/5402 checked MACs/no SETUP_SIGNING/raw key/BAD_DATA. Advanced14 complete+1 partial; network SITL untouched.
disposition: Rekey/disable/operator reconciliation remain unavailable. No ACK or automatic retry; authenticated traffic is not proof of durable vehicle storage and never clears pending. Hidden prior keys may be overwritten via USB/channel exceptions and disconnect other GCS; private-wire consent is mandatory. Shared60s clock advance has1h guard; wrong wall time, native platforms, lost-master recovery, RX restart replay and power-loss durability remain explicit. See MAVLINK_SIGNING_PORT.md.

surface: Shared-link removal and immediate vehicle rediscovery
description: New production rediscovery coverage exposed half-destroyed LinkInterface virtual calls plus dangling pointers in retained AP2DataPlot2D/UASRawStatusView/QGCMapWidget and decoder field zero. LinkManager now detaches all UAS before link destruction, retires registry/companion identities at UASDeleted, disconnects retired protocol ingress and guards deferred companion callbacks against address reuse. Those default views clear/guard old sources; decoder resolves a guarded per-call target before field zero and restores nested state. Full237/237 plus real signed reconnect pass.
disposition: Retain useful legacy modules and the immediate same-sysid/deferred-delete regression. Independently audited lazy HDDisplay.cc:481, HSIDisplay.cc:857 and HUD.cc:249/QGCRGBDView null-source paths still need guarded teardown; do not claim every optional legacy widget lifetime is fixed.

description: The vendored helper can overwrite BAD_CRC with OK at the signed trailer, even when no verification key is configured. MAVLinkFrameParser now consumes the invalid trailer without native verification or success/replay/clock updates and recovers on the following valid frame. Unit tests include valid MAC over invalid CRC; X11 UDP probe rejects40 invalid heartbeats then accepts source232, TLOG has124 valid frames and no BAD_DATA, exit0.
disposition: Application-owned parser fixed; audit direct global-channel generated-parser users, including legacy replay, separately. This CRC repair alone is not authentication; protected production links now separately verify original wire bytes. Local operator UI and persisted protection now exist; vehicle provisioning/change/disable remain gated.

surface: Signing identities and retained replay state
description: Profile signing IDs0..255 persist without recycle; renames consume another ID and may consume another vehicle-side stream (16 in inspected firmware). Retained key contexts are capped256 without eviction so replay history survives remove/rebind; existing keys work at capacity. Raw write-back also requires an active physical epoch on ordinary links; Mirror reports refusal and disables write-back. TCP/UDP payload hex dumps are replaced by length-only metadata.
disposition: Do not delete signing-clock.state to recover ID capacity; no supported registry-reset/migration UI exists. Protected profiles now restore locked before connection. A failed first activation retains the required policy and can safely reserve clock ticks without activating a key. Keep lifetime/capacity/actual-wire regression tests and document these differences in the future UI.

description: Native IF/AND editing, all comparisons/actions/colors/tokens, root repeat, compatible atomic warnings.xml, shared bounded speech and ten-second red HUD are working. Full AND before root cooldown, continuous colors, last matching color precedence and preserved cooldown during edits intentionally fix reference defects; missing/stale values remain idle instead of zero. Source maps 394/486 numeric/bool properties; 92 missing names and producer/units differences remain, including canonical thresholds requiring review for imported feet/knots XML.
disposition: Keep WARNING_MANAGER_PORT.md and WARNING_TELEMETRY_CATALOG.md authoritative. Qt5/audio build and 229/229 tests pass; X11 live color/row values, save/reopen, stale reset and non-silent audio output are verified. Expand missing fields/producers, add per-rule audio delivery diagnostics and verify native platforms before claiming full parity.

surface: Warning editor and native Quick grid
description: The 1250x620 singleton modeless editor retains MP columns and adds availability/unit/import hints; a finite g17 text editor avoids silently clamping imported thresholds. Native Quick renders six MP defaults with reference background/contrast and persistent field/count/column choices; Quick (Legacy) remains separate. Adaptive description/number sizing is now restored using actual label rectangles and local font-size rules that override the production11px theme. Grow/shrink, long strings, warning refresh and1-to12-cell tests plus real-SITL X11 resize evidence pass; raw field labels still differ from reference DisplayText.
disposition: Retain the useful truthful workflow, exact keys and 394-field shared source. Compare remaining reference/native descriptions and visuals; no blank placeholder or fake color consumer is counted.

surface: Quick Home acquisition and unavailable values
description: A late-joining GCS previously waited indefinitely for event-driven HOME_POSITION. Exact REQUEST_MESSAGE(242) now acquires it with fresh heartbeat/position, source/target/physical epoch and single-vehicle route checks; initial0/5/10s intents then30s backoff stop on actual reply. Unknown/stale distance shows a dash, unlike MP10 zero; genuine measured zero including current0 remains visible. Haversine uses radius6371000m instead of MP10 flat TrackerLocation projection. Actual networkSITL192.168.0.43:14556 sys1/1 verifies0.00A andHome distance~0.01m; final234/234 tests pass.
disposition: Keep no-fabricated-zero semantics and HOME_POSITION altitudeMSL. GPS-only gate is intentionally absent for external-nav/EKF Home;512ACK cannot identify a particular requested message. Pre-4.0 GET_HOME_POSITION fallback, operator tracker-home override, per-request send-result feedback and quieter legacy successACK banners remain; see WARNING_TELEMETRY_CATALOG.md.

description: Production setup-route audit initially passed all page checks then crashed after QApplication destruction: static LinkManager destroyed its targets and a surviving MainWindow-owned warning source emitted a Quick repaint into a dead Qt stylesheet. Source state now invalidates without emitting while Qt is closing down; normal runtime target destruction remains observable. Final production process-exit test passes.
disposition: Keep the regression at actual process exit. Follow up with systematic MainWindow singleton/listener teardown before QApplication destruction, including other modeless service observers; the local guard does not prove complete application-lifetime parity.

surface: Anon Log coordinate obfuscation and publication
description: Qt implements all three reference input formats through bounded file workers and atomic staging. Independent BIN-style offsets apply to LOG/TLOG too; the original uses one positive shared offset there. Source overwrite is forbidden, input hashes are checked before publication, and errors/cancel preserve the previous output. Strict malformed/unknown framing and conflicting metadata errors replace reference byte resync or silent frame dropping. Known incomplete non-coordinate BIN tails are preserved with warning; D/U wins per field and unannotated named coordinates use warned fallback, covering RGPJ/RBCH/AIS. Text retains the reference exact-Lat/Lng-only asymmetry. Known out-of-coverage TLOG coordinate messages are named in warnings without inflated counters. TLOG keeps timestamp precision/version, fixes lng recognition and strips invalidated signatures with a visible count. Current TLOG privacy filtering additionally drops GPS_INJECT_DATA/GPS_RTCM_DATA/FILE_TRANSFER_PROTOCOL/LOG_DATA/SETUP_SIGNING and ambiguous COMMAND_LONG/INT, including every sender and zero offsets, with aggregate warnings and retained-record counts. Explicit global COMMAND_INT x/y is shifted; known non-coordinate commands remain. This does not sanitize identifiers, altitude/time, free text, other embedded payloads or every coordinate-bearing message.
disposition: Keep the obfuscation-only warning, default-Cancel confirmation, exact job tokens and staging ownership. Qt5/audio/Concurrent build and 225/225 tests pass; X11, two real SITL BINs, independent GPS/CRC/bytes and a 105 MB bounded-memory probe pass. Keep broader real-log/native-platform gates in ANON_LOG_PORT.md. Track unknown dialect coverage, unsupported BIN coordinate encodings and geographic normalization explicitly; never claim cryptographic verification or complete privacy.

description: A modeless 760x740 file/offset/progress/result window replaces MP10's chained alert and input dialogs. It remains usable offline, closing detaches the observer, reopening resumes the same application job, and only explicit Cancel or application shutdown cancels processing. Result counters distinguish coordinate matches and changed values, and signature removal is visible.
disposition: Preserve the original Advanced Tools position and wording where behavior corresponds. Compare detailed reference/native-platform styling later without removing the usable progress, cancellation or privacy information.

description: Qt uses an explicit generic-component selector independent of the active autopilot, bounded RAW8U assembly, domain-tagged central exact parameter arbitration and one pre-UAS parameter ingress. VIDEO_ONLY is read from the actual sensor and Focus/Video changes only on an exact typed ACK. Page hide and source changes retain application-owned cleanup on the original component instance; ambiguous reset outcomes stay visible. Offline availability matches MP10 and deliberately bypasses unrelated autopilot parameter loading. The previous inventory incorrectly assigned firmware upload to this page; neither reference page implements it.
disposition: Keep strict geometry and negotiated-payload validation, distinct-packet completion, physical/component epochs, bounded quarantine/reconciliation and no successor writes. Do not claim wire frame identity where MAVLink carries none. Qt5/audio build and 221/221 tests pass; production X11 verifies both frame sizes, exact mode ACKs, page-hide zero cleanup, stale recovery and disconnect/reconnect. Retain physical sensor, real replay, shutdown-drain and native-platform gates in PX4FLOW_PORT.md.

surface: PX4Flow focus warning and source presentation
description: The native title/status/aspect-fit image/Focus-Video surface follows MP10. Qt adds an explicit source combo, stale/partial-frame diagnostics and a default-Cancel bench/disarmed warning because VIDEO_ONLY may suspend optical-flow measurements. MP10 changes its button optimistically and silently no-ops when the sensor parameter list was not fetched; Qt reports read/write failure. Replay is read-only rather than exposing a live parameter action.
disposition: Retain source clarity and the focus warning. Align detailed theme/spacing against reference screenshots later; do not equate a green Linux build with physical PX4Flow or Windows/macOS verification.

description: Native Param gen parses nine master/stable source roots and refreshes all nine products with bounded HTTP, strict same-ref .cpp/.h recursion, atomic per-file publication and truthful partial/cancel outcomes. It fixes conditional leaks, empty/anonymous group handling, Tracker aliases, metadata block pollution, inferred-only 404s, obsolete stable Rover ref and the unawaited MP10 PDEF task. Plain XML and native generated PDEF replace gzip/legacy XML. Official-network probe and X11 publish ten artifacts; 216 tests pass.
disposition: Retain corrected semantics, 4096 contexts/1024 URLs/depth24, 64MiB source cache, 200k parsed records/32Mi chars and 16MiB output bounds. CPU parsing/compose remains synchronous and bounded; move it to a cancellable worker if measured latency grows. Preserve per-artifact partial reporting, not a false multi-file atomic claim.

surface: Metadata trust and page refresh scope
description: Vehicle metadata falls back per missing field through SITL libraries, AP_Periph and generated source; explicit false/empty values block fallback. Publication invalidates both repository instances lazily without resetting live pages or edits. The existing trust API is catalog-wide: any fallback-added range downgrades the entire merged catalog to advisory, including intact exact ranges. Heli/Blimp are validated and cached but not yet separate active-family mappings.
disposition: Add per-field range provenance across every consumer before restoring exact range enforcement selectively. Implement safe idle-page hot refresh, Heli/Blimp selection and Local override/legacy XML interchange separately. Until then save/apply edits and finish operations before reconnect/restart; do not promise navigating to a cached page refreshes it.

description: Qt adds a modeless 760x560 progress/artifact/log observer with explicit Cancel and recoverable job state; MP10 uses confirmation and coarse page logs. The observer can close and reopen without cancelling the application job. Real X11 verifies enabled offline Advanced entry, confirmation, 10/10 result, continued progress after reopen, cancellation and clean shutdown.
disposition: Retain useful progress and truthful lifetime/status. Align final layout and native-platform presentation later; source graph progress has a dynamically discovered total.

description: Native ConfigFFTView and independent window retain MP10 Hann normalization and per-window magnitude/dB averaging, six batch ACC/GYR instances, IMU fallback and informational notch suggestion. Qt fixes the dropped last/only complete window and wrong averaging divisor, fractional-frequency truncation, incomplete packet correlation and unbounded input. Sixteen pending headers evict oldest incomplete batches; one 2097152-sample cap and cancellable workers bound resources. Noncontiguous bursts never form one FFT; insufficient data suggests lower Bins or greater INS_LOG_BAT_CNT. IMU timing uses median intervals; mixed rates use the dominant complete-window group.
disposition: Retain numerical fixes, bounds and exact packet identity. Validate representative field logs, minority-rate diagnostics and malformed-window behavior before strict parity. Do not alias FFT to the separate time-frequency Spectrogram tool.

description: Qt uses metadata numeric controls and real checkable bitmask menus for CNT/MASK/LOG_BITMASK instead of MP10 hard-coded 32..4096 sliders. Independent windows are modeless 1000x700 and show all XYZ curves. Exact-zero dB data is retained but the initial graph displays 160 dB below the maximum so -6466 dB bins do not flatten useful peaks. Setup hides the page while disconnected like MP10; Advanced FFT still supports offline files.
disposition: Keep usable editors and graph scale; align reference/native-platform layout and formatting later. Do not claim a live FFT sensor stream or automatic notch-parameter writes.

surface: Single-vehicle parameter routes and shutdown ownership
description: Live X11 exposed the overly strict inherited Swarm route gate on ordinary UDP. A separate selected-target single-vehicle reservation policy permits supported serial/TCP/UDP-client and exactly one learned UDP peer while pinning generation, instance, link epoch and peer revision; reserve/submit/retry/receive retirement preserves shared ACK arbitration and quarantine. Default Swarm validation is unchanged. Firmware-page hide/destruction now uses a lifetime-guarded header instead of the stale MainWindow singleton. Full build, 213 tests and real X11 parameter ACK/refresh/clean-exit evidence pass.
disposition: Retain separate single-vehicle versus Swarm policies and runtime UDP/lifetime regressions. Verify physical serial/FC/native-platform workflows separately; peer identity is not authentication.

surface: Download Logs exact ownership and atomic output
description: Qt replaces the production legacy active-UAS dialog with an application-owned exact link/session/vehicle/peer service, bounded retry and one operation owner. A completed list cannot be reused for another vehicle. Cancel/close discards incomplete QSaveFile output and joins KML work; both BIN and KML overwrites require approval. Listening UDP requires one peer, stamps ingress and queues original-destination envelopes; peer changes retire the old epoch. Erase submits two frames but truthfully reports unconfirmed completion. Finite GPS-only KML export also handles single-FMT logs through private parser subclasses; general LogAnalysis/Spectrogram deferred-first-FMT behavior is unchanged. Full build, 206 tests and synthetic-peer X11 Selected/All/hash/KML/cancel/erase/clean-exit evidence pass.
disposition: Retain exact ownership, atomic output and honest erase status. Verify physical FC/serial/TCP, real onboard logs and native platforms separately; optimize the bounded per-byte deferred map later. Do not describe transport submission as delivery or peer revisions as authentication.

description: The native 540x440 minimum420x320 window reproduces the wrapping six-control toolbar, Id/Date/Size grid, aggregate progress and modeless lifetime. Qt adds source identity and more explicit failure/erase wording; a second window disables shared-service actions while another operation owns the protocol, without a detailed owner explanation. MainWindow closes all owned download windows before transport teardown. Real-X11 production navigation and modal-destruction tests pass; exact reference screenshot and native-platform typography remain.
disposition: Keep the functional route and source safety. Refine toolbar/status geometry, busy-owner explanation and typography in the later visual pass; never replace Download Logs with an empty legacy widget.

description: MP10 discovers swarm vehicles through mutable global connection objects and system IDs. Qt admits at most 24 command-capable autopilot endpoints through HEARTBEAT and identifies each instance by physical link, sysid, compid, link-session epoch and instance epoch. Only HEARTBEAT renews the five-second lease; reconnect/rebind, stale heartbeat, loss of command capability and meaningful boot-time rollback retire it. Position, velocity, attitude, landed state, MISSION_CURRENT and NAV_CONTROLLER_OUTPUT are retained as separate timestamped atomic observations, so consumers never assemble a logical field from different packets or instances.
disposition: Retain exact physical identity, bounded admission and all-or-nothing group validation. Every swarm consumer must request the required stream set, validate each consumed field's validity and age, reject non-unique UDP broadcast routing, revalidate plans after confirmation and report partial transport sends honestly.

description: MP10 combines mutable editor state with Run Step and Takeoff commands, does not require Copters already in GUIDED for Run Step and treats queued unacknowledged position targets as success. Qt keeps the bounded/atomic offline workflow but routes commands through one application-owned executor: the window freezes revision, layout step, anchor and one-to-one assignments around a default-Cancel prompt; the executor repeats exact link/session/vehicle-instance validation after reserving Swarm then VehicleCommand ownership and drains in reverse. Run intentionally tightens safety by requiring every target already in exact ArduCopter GUIDED, requesting POSITION at 10 Hz and then queuing zero-velocity relative-altitude global targets. Takeoff serializes per assigned vehicle GUIDED ACK → newer heartbeat → ARM ACK → newer heartbeat → TAKEOFF 2 m ACK; known rejects continue to later vehicles, while `PartialEffect` and `OutcomeUncertain` block restart. Closing the window cancels only its owned operation generation. Files remain capped at 8 MiB and atomically saved; backgrounds remain session-only and bounded, and ambiguous aliases/sparse overflow are rejected.
disposition: Retain immutable pre/post-confirmation and post-reservation validation, exact-case layout references, full endpoint epochs, deterministic vehicle order, default-Cancel confirmation, reverse drain and fail-closed restart blocking. Add focused/full-suite and replacement X11 evidence, reconnect/reboot/nested-confirmation regressions, live multi-vehicle command evidence and an explicit operator reconciliation/acknowledgement path before strict parity. Do not weaken the exact-GUIDED Run gate or replace ACK stages with fire-and-forget commands.

surface: Swarm Formation exact routing and partial command surface
description: MP10 sends Formation commands through mutable global MAV records, permits the transport's broad routing and uses position-target masks with reserved high bits. Qt reserves one complete exact-instance group, requests telemetry before a bounded three-second bootstrap, sends clean-mask 0x0DC0 Copter/Rover position+velocity targets at at most 10 Hz only through connected TCP or UDP Client links, rejects Null Island after wire rounding and stops on route/session/member change or partial transport failure. A reservation may intentionally use flight mode Any while a workflow is preparing a mode transition, but every actual position-target send performs a fresh exact ArduPilot GUIDED check before the batch and again after each route callback. The recognizable Plane PID, yaw/gimbal and bulk flight controls remain visible but disabled rather than implying unsupported behavior; Serial/radio and listening UDP are also locked because uniqueness is not proven.
disposition: Retain all-or-nothing exact group validation, mandatory per-send GUIDED and post-callback barriers, consumed-field freshness, deterministic slot order, bounded rate and default-Cancel confirmation. Add yaw/gimbal, Plane attitude/PID and bulk arm/mode/takeoff/land only through the shared exact sender and single VehicleCommandService ACK arbiter. Add a reviewed dedicated-serial route policy, checked write/enqueue semantics, live multi-vehicle evidence, reference screenshots and native-platform verification before strict parity.

surface: Swarm Follow Path exact routing and partial command surface
description: MP10 switches each follower to GUIDED on every tick, sends Copter/Rover position targets and uses a Plane guided MISSION_ITEM plus MISSION_ACK path. Qt requires Copter/Rover followers already to be in the family-specific ArduPilot GUIDED custom mode because the MAV_MODE_FLAG_GUIDED_ENABLED bit is ambiguous, checks route eligibility before confirmation and on every batch, records a bounded newest-first trail and queues clean-mask 0x0DF8 position-only targets at 5 Hz through one exact-instance session. Full member/mode validation is repeated after injected route callbacks immediately before physical writes; UI route checks operate on value copies and revalidate exact instances. Plane may lead but cannot follow; automatic mode switching and bulk flight commands remain visible but disabled. Serial/radio and listening UDP routes remain locked because exact delivery is not proven.
disposition: Retain newest-first interpolated trail placement, whole-batch withholding, exact group/field/mode/route validation, post-callback send barriers, bounded bootstrap/rate and partial-send stop. Add exact mode control, Plane guided MISSION_ITEM/ACK and bulk arm/takeoff/land only through shared application-owned arbiters; add dedicated Serial policy, checked enqueue, live/reference/native evidence before strict parity.

surface: Swarm Follow Leader exact routing, GUIDED gate and partial command surface
description: MP10 uses mutable connection records, sends a 10 Hz position+velocity group without an exact GUIDED precondition, and exposes fire-and-forget Arm, Disarm, Takeoff, GUIDED, NAV GUIDED and AUTO commands. Qt reserves the complete ground/air/follower group by physical link, sysid, compid and link/instance epochs, requires every commanded ArduCopter role already in exact custom-mode GUIDED, requires fresh ground position and velocity, and sends clean-mask 0x0DC0 targets at at most 10 Hz only through TCP or UDP Client. The observed ground master is route-gated because requesting its POSITION stream is a physical send. Topology, settings, role, eligibility, reconnect, stale telemetry, GPS jump and partial batch changes stop the session. The exposed Lead value remains unused as in MP10. Near-waypoint geometry is implemented and tested with fresh VFR_HUD groundspeed plus a safe N/E fallback. Exact mission/current-navigation telemetry and the shared ACK arbiter now exist as application foundations, but the production Follow Leader window has not yet adopted them; all six bulk commands remain visibly disabled.
disposition: Retain exact group reservation, post-callback route/member/mode barriers, whole-batch withholding, bounded 10 Hz rate, explicit confirmation and terminal partial-send handling. Wire a generation/digest-pinned exact mission lease into every turn tick before enabling anticipation, and route bulk commands through the central exact endpoint reservation/ACK arbiter plus an all-or-nothing group executor. Add reviewed Serial/radio policy, live multi-vehicle/reference/native evidence and cadence measurements before strict parity.

surface: Central exact multi-endpoint command ACK arbitration
description: MP10 swarm tools issue commands through mutable per-vehicle objects and often advance without one application-wide ACK owner. Qt's VehicleCommandService now reserves exact endpoint sets, permits parallel commands only across distinct endpoints, installs the pending waiter before the physical write, correlates COMMAND_ACK by link/session/sysid/compid/command/target, extends progress deadlines on IN_PROGRESS but caps them at one absolute operation lifetime, and quarantines timeout or uncertain-write outcomes so late ACKs cannot satisfy a new command. Owner destruction, lease retirement and synchronous route reentrancy drain deterministically.
disposition: Keep this as the sole ACK-bearing swarm command arbiter. Build the all-or-nothing group executor on its reservation tokens, cancel remaining members on the first terminal failure and surface partial/uncertain outcomes; do not reintroduce per-window ACK listeners or permit continuous IN_PROGRESS to extend an operation forever.

surface: Exact mission snapshot ownership and mutation invalidation
description: MP10 reads mission state from a broad mutable current connection. Qt downloads MISSION/FENCE/RALLY through one exact link/session/sysid/compid/type transaction owned by the per-UAS MissionProtocolCoordinator, publishes only complete immutable snapshots and binds leases to content generation plus digest. Competing upload/clear ownership and passive accepted mission ACKs invalidate cached data; reconnect and vehicle retirement cancel/invalidate it. MAVLink 1 refuses extension mission types at preflight and every send barrier. Zero-item missions are valid atomic snapshots. Because the retained legacy UAS layer is keyed primarily by sysid, equal sysids on separate links can conservatively share/lose coordinator availability even though the exact snapshot keys remain distinct.
disposition: Retain coordinator ownership, explicit MissionOwnerBusy reporting, per-send exact route/version barriers, atomic replacement ordering and generation/digest validation in every mission consumer. Integrate explicit mutation invalidation into every new upload/clear path, then replace legacy sysid coordinator lookup with exact-UAS ownership and add live mixed legacy/exact mission evidence before broad use.

description: MP10 combines UI state, mutable vehicle objects and flight commands in one workflow. Qt isolates a deterministic controller and application-owned adapter/executor with exact role/mission binding, bounded relative-altitude-only path geometry, per-vehicle GUIDED then ARM heartbeat barriers, single-issue TAKEOFF, line/V/interleaved targets, return/landing and collision separation. The enabled 1320x790 modeless route discovers full physical-link/session/instance leases, owns only its exact mission-refresh token and hides a pre-refresh mission until a strictly newer complete observation arrives. The executor atomically reserves Swarm, VehicleCommand and Parameter ownership, revalidates after reservation, discovers aliases/runtime types by exact read, serializes every intent, requires newer heartbeat evidence after ACKs and stops retries before reverse draining. The persistent RTL_ALT=0/RTL_ALT_M=0 initialization write remains behind the window's default-Cancel warning. Start is disabled while draining or terminal uncertainty is latched, and LinkManager cancels before route teardown. Unit/full-suite and production-menu X11 lifecycle evidence pass.
disposition: Preserve pre-submission callbacks, full token/run-generation correlation, exact mission ownership, bounded recovery and fail-closed uncertainty. Add an explicit default-Cancel operator acknowledgement for terminal OutcomeUncertain after vehicle reconciliation, then live multi-vehicle flight, reference screenshots and native-platform evidence. Never cancel another owner's mission transaction or replace the executor with optimistic fire-and-forget dispatch.

description: All direct MP10 controls are represented and the daily mission/polygon/file/transfer controls work, but seven advanced actions remain disabled.
disposition: Implement Grid/KML/custom XYZ/fence undo as one package, then WMS/WMTS and MAVFTP/Write Fast; keep each action unavailable until end-to-end behavior exists.

description: The top-aligned scrollable action stack leaves unused space below its contents; MP10 uses the same StackPanel-in-ScrollViewer behavior, although exact geometry differs.
disposition: Accept for the usable-program milestone and revisit during screenshot-driven visual polish.

description: View KML is currently a disabled placeholder; imported KML/KMZ/GeoJSON overlays are not available through the PLAN action panel.
disposition: Implement a backend-neutral overlay/import flow shared by all map backends.

description: Several advanced map controls are present as disabled placeholders.
disposition: Classify against MP10 and implement in useful packages; never enable an inert control.

description: Fast mission transfer controls are not implemented end to end.
disposition: Keep visibly unavailable until transport, cancellation, error handling and tests exist.

description: DockableView previously gave the splitter an expanding wrapper frame while only the inner FlightPlannerActionPanel was fixed to 168 px; on wide windows the wrapper grew and left a visible empty strip between the controls and the right edge.
disposition: The panel wrapper and content now share an explicit one-axis fixed extent: ActionPanel is 168 px wide and WaypointPanel is 210 px high. Production-order geometry tests cover 1120/1280/1600 widths, exact right-edge ownership, hide/show and layout restore; the intentional inner margin and scrollbar remain inside the action column.

description: The PLAN waypoint table now exposes visible per-row Up, Down and Delete controls through a proxy while reusing the existing move/delete QActions and their store-aware undo and DO_JUMP remapping.
disposition: Keep the row-action columns wired to the shared operations; unit coverage locks clicked-row selection, first/last-row guards, deletion and keyboard activation.

description: Vertical speed reaches FlightDataViewModel and HudControl, but Qt renders it only as an unlabeled blue VSI needle that is invisible at zero and easy to miss against the HUD; the user-visible numeric climb/descent value is absent.
disposition: Keep the MP10 VSI and add a signed numeric m/s presentation, then audit every HUD field and lock positive, negative, zero, target-change and paint-region behavior.

description: Qt QPainter keeps brush state between draw calls, unlike the explicit nullable brushes in the MP10 drawing context. The AOA arrow left an opaque black brush active, so the following speed/altitude outline draw also filled both translucent tapes black.
disposition: Keep AOA and VSI drawing inside save/restore and set NoBrush explicitly for tape outlines. Preserve the pixel regression proving the left tape is identical with AOA disabled or enabled.

description: Tools creates a new explicit modeless top-level MAVLinkInspectorWindow for every invocation. Each native view owns one pinned physical-link or replay-generation source and closing its parent destroys the subscriptions.
disposition: Retain independent modeless ownership and shutdown coverage. Graphs, outbound traffic, modern dialect and remaining reference geometry belong to separate functional/GUI rows.

description: The header exposes the exact 24 MP10 items, order, separators and shortcuts. In the verified Qt Multimedia build all 24 routes have production handlers and open a modeless window or the specific Developer Tools page; the final Waypoint Leader entry now opens its complete exact-adapter surface. A build without Qt Multimedia enables 23/24 and disables only OSD Video rather than exposing an inert action. Legacy DATA/PLAN/SIM docks, HIL actions and custom .qgw containers cannot enter this menu; installed trusted QML tools may append one explicit extension submenu. The catalogue test invokes every compiled handler, and a real X11 click proves the Waypoint Leader MainWindow route and independent lifecycle.
disposition: Keep compile-time feature absences visibly disabled, layout/panel toggles in their owning views and the invariant that every enabled Tools action has a visible outcome independent of the current main view. Remaining partial controls inside opened tools are tracked separately and must not be presented as complete until their end-to-end workflows are verified.

surface: Link Statistics rates and no-link state
description: MP10 counts bytes received during each one-second timer bucket on its single MAVLinkInterface. Qt reuses LinkInterface's short rolling bit-rate estimate, converts it to bytes per second and follows the current exact target's physical link; it also represents missing target/link state explicitly, which MP10's global comPort cannot express.
disposition: Retain exact physical-link selection, per-tick pointer re-resolution and the explicit zero/em-dash no-link state. Revisit the smoothing interval only if live comparison shows an operator-visible mismatch.

description: The Qt Tlog Convert window implements KML, GPX, CSV, human-readable text, parameter and complete mission-snapshot exports, but its Matlab button is visibly disabled because the port has no reviewed cross-platform MAT-file writer. MP10 writes a .mat beside the selected tlog through its bundled .NET writer.
disposition: Keep the button disabled with an explicit reason until a Qt MAT-file writer produces a MATLAB-loadable, schema-compatible result with atomic failure/cancellation and representative-log tests; do not emit a renamed CSV file or another misleading substitute.

description: MP10 writes the selected export path and automatically named mission snapshot siblings with overwrite semantics. Qt still permits replacement of the explicitly selected destination after the native Save As confirmation, but refuses any destination that resolves to the source tlog and refuses to overwrite pre-existing implicit -2/-3 mission siblings.
disposition: Retain the input-file guard in both the window and export service, canonical-path checks for generated siblings and explicit errors for unconfirmed sibling collisions. Never trade the only source telemetry log for exact overwrite parity.

description: MP10 also forwards a parser-specific bad-CRC packet when its message ID is unknown to the active dialect. Qt mirrors only packets that complete successful per-link MAVLink framing; corrupt or unknown-CRC candidates remain excluded.
disposition: Retain the post-framing complete-packet tap so arbitrary transport noise and partial frames never reach the secondary GCS. Revisit only with byte-exact fixtures for MP10's unknown-message quirk.

description: MP10 uses one global current comPort. Qt snapshots the current exact target's physical link ID at Start, never silently retargets a running mirror, and stops it explicitly if that link disconnects or is removed.
disposition: Retain immutable link identity and per-write link lookup. Never store a LinkInterface pointer in the window, view model or mirror service.

description: MP10 opens a shared UDP 14550 listener beside its primary listener, while ordinary unicast delivery between reused sockets is platform-dependent. Qt refuses UDP Host - 14550 while an active vehicle UDP link already owns that port instead of risking stolen or split telemetry.
disposition: Keep the refusal visible and allow TCP Host or a disconnected primary link. Reconsider only with a central datagram fan-out broker that deterministically delivers one input to both consumers on every platform.

description: MP10 retains every learned UDP sender without a bound and reports mirroring immediately after opening the shared listener. Qt fans mirrored datagrams to learned distinct peers but caps the list at 32, evicts the oldest peer and reports Listening until the first datagram identifies a destination.
disposition: Retain deterministic bounded peer learning, the truthful no-destination status and best-effort per-peer sends; cover fan-out plus eviction in transport tests.

description: MP10 swallows a secondary-to-vehicle write exception. Qt leaves vehicle-to-peer mirroring active but disables the write-back checkbox and appends an explicit failure note when the pinned physical link rejects raw bytes.
disposition: Retain the fail-closed reverse path and keep the checkbox synchronized with service state so the UI never claims that raw vehicle writes remain enabled.

description: MP10 combines UTC time fields with DateTime.Now's local calendar date in RMC. Qt uses one coherent UTC timestamp for both time and date, so midnight near a local timezone boundary can differ from MP10.
disposition: Retain the coherent UTC timestamp and golden checksum coverage; do not reproduce a mixed-timezone navigation record.

description: MP10 follows the mutable current vehicle of one global comPort. Qt snapshots the exact `(link, sysid, compid)` endpoint at Connect, rejects every other endpoint and stops with an explicit status when that physical link disconnects or is removed.
disposition: Retain immutable endpoint identity and synchronous link-ID extraction. Never retain a LinkInterface pointer or silently retarget a running output.

description: MP10 begins emitting zero coordinates immediately. Qt writes nothing until the first usable GLOBAL_POSITION_INT or any GPS_RAW_INT; matching MP10 CurrentState semantics, a GPS_RAW_INT without a fix can still yield zero coordinates with GGA quality 0.
disposition: Retain the pre-position-message gate and explicit running status; test that ticks before either position message write nothing.

description: MP10 swallows output exceptions and can continue to claim that it is emitting. Qt surfaces the transport/write failure, stops the timer and releases the output session.
disposition: Retain fail-closed lifecycle and a stable visible error until the operator starts a new session.

description: MP10 retains an unbounded UDP endpoint list. Qt reuses the bounded secondary UDP transport: distinct learned senders are capped at 32 with oldest eviction, and every NMEA sentence is one complete datagram.
disposition: Retain bounded peer learning and whole-sentence datagrams; preserve the UDP no-peer preview behavior.

description: The Qt formatter deliberately preserves MP10 wire quirks for compatibility: VTG omits the standard T/M/N/K unit letters, GLL/RMC can report status A without a valid fix, and RMC/GLL coordinate precision is not uniformly padded.
disposition: Keep byte-golden tests for MP10 compatibility. Revisit only behind an explicit standards-compliant output mode rather than silently changing the existing stream.

description: MP10 follows one mutable global comPort and its MAV list. Qt pins the current target's physical link at Connect, emits independently for every exact system/component endpoint discovered on that link, and stops visibly if the link is lost.
disposition: Retain immutable physical-link identity, per-message exact endpoint filtering and synchronous link-ID extraction. Never retain a LinkInterface pointer or silently retarget a running output.

description: MP10 can emit zero coordinates immediately. Qt emits nothing for an endpoint until its first GLOBAL_POSITION_INT, GPS_RAW_INT, HIGH_LATENCY or HIGH_LATENCY2 position update; a valid zero coordinate remains accepted.
disposition: Retain the per-endpoint position gate so a plausible-looking zero location is not fabricated before telemetry arrives.

description: MP10 leaves TCP clients, pending writes and identity input effectively unbounded. Qt caps TCP Host at 16 clients, each client queue and the last-event preview at 64 KiB, an event datagram at 65507 bytes, identity rows at 1024, cells at 4096 characters and identity JSON at 2 MiB; slow/broken peers are dropped with visible status.
disposition: Retain deterministic bounds and fail-closed lifecycle. Raise a bound only with measured operational evidence and corresponding stress coverage.

description: Qt rejects non-finite navigation data, invalid UTC input and characters forbidden by XML 1.0 on a per-event basis, retaining a visible warning rather than allowing MP10's XmlWriter exception/retry loop. Settings use the fresh MissionPlanner/Tools/CotOutput QSettings group with no legacy migration.
disposition: Retain validation, LF wire framing and the fresh-port namespace. Preserve MP10 XML order, precision, escaping and platform-native indentation for valid events.

description: Qt intentionally writes AMSL metres to point/@hae and constant ce/le="1.0" exactly like MP10, although CoT terminology normally expects height above ellipsoid and accuracy estimates. HIGH_LATENCY/HIGH_LATENCY2 course uses their heading because MP10 leaves the prior groundcourse stale.
disposition: Preserve the MP10 wire values for compatibility and the corrected deterministic high-latency heading; expose standards-oriented alternatives only as an explicit future mode.

description: MP10 can open UDP Host on a port already used by the active vehicle link, with platform-dependent datagram delivery. Qt refuses that selection visibly rather than risking stolen or split telemetry.
disposition: Keep the collision check and direct the operator to a free UDP port or another transport. Reconsider only with a central cross-platform datagram fan-out broker.

description: MP10 accepts the first DEVICE_OP reply from the requested system/component during its one-second wait without checking request_id. Qt also requires the pinned physical link, exact reply type and process-unique request_id, and invalidates every pending operation when the target generation or link changes.
disposition: Retain full-envelope correlation and explicit rebind; never allow a stale reply or another independent Device Operations window to complete the wrong request.

description: MP10 can run the ICM20948 write/read test with an unknown armed state and checks the active vehicle even when edited System/Component fields address another endpoint. Qt requires a confirmed disarmed heartbeat from the exact lease, restricts this destructive test to that bound endpoint, rechecks target and arming between write and read, and gives Cancel the default/Escape role.
disposition: Retain the fail-closed endpoint and arming checks. Ordinary read-only register access may keep MP10's editable destination on the pinned physical link.

description: Qt uses a non-blocking one-second QTimer instead of MP10's worker-thread polling, refuses v2-only DEVICE_OP messages on MAVLink 1, disables the SPI-only ICM test for I2C instead of silently returning, and includes the pinned link name in its bound-target status. Both keep one pending operation per window and persist no Device Operations settings.
disposition: Retain the event-driven per-window session, explicit protocol/version errors and no-persistence contract; keep each invocation independent and modeless.

surface: DataFlash Spectrogram bounds and batch repair
description: MP10 caches complete parsed logs and its original batch sensor selector aliases instances 3–5 to instance 3. Qt streams only selected rows through a parser-sink interface, maps ACC/GYR 1–5 to exact instances 0–4, correlates current QHBBHHQf/QHHaaa ISBH/ISBD batches, accepts flattened or bracketed ASCII int16[32] fields, falls back to complete direct rows when batches are incomplete, caps selected input at 2,097,152 samples and output width at 2048 by default, and exposes explicit cancellation. A sink refusal stops both ASCII and binary parsers synchronously after the rejected row. Rendering retains the 1024-point Hann/20-log10 rainbow workflow with separate X/Y/Z images, while maximum-pooling all FFT windows into bounded raster columns avoids dropping short transients. Qt also prefers SampleUS for modern direct rows, uses median sample timing, formats time ranges to fixed precision and silently ignores minority-rate complete batches.
disposition: Retain the strict bounds, exact instance mapping, off-UI cancellation, maximum pooling and independent window lifecycle. Validate representative current and older physical logs before strict completion, expose a minority-rate notice if physical logs demonstrate ambiguity, and raise bounds only with measured memory/runtime evidence and stress tests.

surface: 3D Terrain software renderer and guarded gaps
description: MP10 defaults to optional map imagery and can send a guided target from the terrain click. Qt ports the bounded software heightfield renderer over the shared GDAL/SRTM elevation service with exact-target telemetry, cancellable worker/value snapshots, fog, elevation shading, grid, MAV marker, locked/free camera and read-only terrain inspection. Imagery and its zoom controls are visibly disabled rather than creating a second tile cache; guided sends remain explicitly disabled even though the shared exact-target guided service now exists. The unrelated old OSG/QGLWidget Pixhawk3DWidget remains unbuilt and is not presented as the MP10 tool.
disposition: Add imagery only through the canonical OPMaps cache/provider with a bounded in-memory atlas of at most 64 tiles. Enable guided clicks only after adding a current-altitude source, per-click default-Cancel confirmation, explicit armed/mode policy and dedicated UI/service tests. Keep the old OSG widget isolated.

surface: External Guided command safety and legacy fallback
description: MP10 waits for DO_REPOSITION but falls back after failure to Plane MISSION_ITEM current=2 or unacknowledged SET_POSITION_TARGET_GLOBAL_INT and its backend silently suppresses a target when either coordinate is zero. Qt requires a fresh generation-bound exact target, terminal Accepted DO_REPOSITION acknowledgement and one serialized owner, rejects only the ambiguous (0,0) point, rereads the file after consent and stops on target change. Identical pending commands retry at most three times; an Accepted result after retry drains possible additional retry ACKs before another coordinate is sent. Stop releases the UI/session immediately, while ambiguous outcomes use a bounded six-second late-ACK isolation interval. Because COMMAND_ACK carries no transaction ID or echoed coordinates, time isolation cannot mathematically prove that an arbitrarily delayed ACK belongs to the latest coordinates.
disposition: Keep UI wording truthful about command-level acknowledgement and retain exact-link/generation/heartbeat gates. Add legacy fallback only with protocol-specific completion/error reporting and older-autopilot evidence. Revisit timed recovery if a wire transaction token becomes available; do not claim coordinate-level acknowledgement from COMMAND_ACK alone.

surface: Follow Me input and command safety
description: MP10 emits fixed-rate guided updates without per-command acknowledgement and retains legacy vehicle-specific fallback paths. Qt validates manual or framed serial GGA input, requires a fresh immutable exact target and default-Cancel movement warning, reserves the shared guided owner before opening serial and sends newest-only DO_REPOSITION updates only after terminal acknowledgement. Invalid, no-fix or stale input withholds movement; target/link/input/close events stop the session. Exact (0,0) is rejected as ambiguous, while either zero axis is valid. A heartbeat gap longer than the shared freshness bound terminates rather than silently continuing.
disposition: Retain the exact-target, serial-before-command, freshness, ACK, coalescing and fail-closed lifecycle contracts. Add legacy compatibility only with truthful result semantics and older-autopilot evidence; complete physical serial/live-vehicle, reference screenshot and native-platform validation.

surface: Moving Base input, exact session and map marker
description: Qt opens a fresh 580x500 modeless window from TOOLS and SETUP Advanced, reserves one immutable exact target before opening Serial/TCP/UDP input, publishes rate-limited GGA fixes to a backend-neutral cyan BASE marker on Flight Data and clears it on no-fix, stale input, target/link/owner loss or Stop. Input is bounded by a 4096-byte framer and 64 KiB device buffers; TCP Host keeps the newest client, UDP Host pins the first sender and refuses an active MAVLink UDP port with an exclusive bind, and UDP Client announces its ephemeral return port with one empty datagram before accepting only the configured endpoint. Settings persist only after Listening/Ready and the raw log is capped at 4 MiB plus one capped backup. Exact (0,0) remains valid store data but is hidden by the map. TCP Client has no automatic reconnect, and unlike MP10 the Qt position does not feed NTRIP GGA.
disposition: Retain the exact target, pre-input reservation, exclusive port, bounded input/log and stale-clear contracts. Keep Relative Altitude visibly disabled until an exact-target home-altitude source exists, and keep Rally Point 0 disabled until a current MAV_MISSION_TYPE_RALLY transaction has explicit MISSION_ACK correlation and reconciliation. Complete physical/network/live-marker, reference screenshot and native-platform evidence.

description: The MP10 16-action inventory is represented; MAVLink Inspector, Mavlink Mirror, NMEA, Cursor-on-Target / TAK, DataFlash Spectrogram, External Guided, Follow Me, Moving Base, Map Tile Cache, Proximity, FFT and Param gen route to twelve working shared tools, while four actions remain explicitly unavailable. Param gen now has a real modeless application-owned download/parser/cache workflow; its specific differences are tracked separately. A saved Advanced page may be created before MainWindow registers TOOLS actions, so Qt explicitly rebuilds this lazy page after action registration; the production route audit reproduces that ordering and real X11 opens Inspector from the restored enabled page.
disposition: Retain late action recovery independently of startup order. Incrementally replace disabled entries with complete workflows without duplicating services.

description: The exact32-action MP10 inventory now has15 working implementations: five parsers/shared windows and six guarded exact-target pressure/calibration-recovery/reboot/DFU actions and offline GPS correction extraction plus DataFlash splitting and DashWare CSV, plus direct MAVFTP download with remote-path/Save prompts, pre-prompt exact lease, owned cancellation, 30-second deadline and atomic output. Split uses whole BIN/text records, metadata prefixes, tail warnings, staged no-overwrite output and truthful partial publication. App-owned immutable plans, fresh disarmed checks, REAL32 pressure with existing BRD_OPTIONS capability, dual-lane reservation and per-attempt gates are tested. Full243/243 and offscreen/X11 actual Tools route with in-process fixture pass;17 other file/transport/recovery actions remain unavailable.
disposition: DashWare preserves sparse source-order rows, raw clocks, MP10 schema/modes and quoted cells through bounded scans and atomic confirmed output. Fix the older browser prompt-time target-consent gap next, then remaining single-vehicle/offline workflows; outbound TLOG recording with secret exclusion is wired while recording is active; retain page-before-actions regression. Do not infer physical DFU entry from link loss or acknowledged reboot completion. Native platforms/physical actions remain unverified; preserve existing PARAM isolation fence and Swarm restrictions.

description: The native responsive32-action grid and log are retained; six vehicle actions use named nonblocking numeric/confirmation dialogs with default Cancel, exact target identity and explicit recovery/DFU risks. GPS extraction adds native Qt file pickers and modeless progress/cancel, with counts and explicit corruption/older-log/recording-enabled warnings rather than MP10's single success line. Direct MAVFTP adds path (default @SYS/threads.txt), Save and modeless progress/cancel dialogs without replacing the full browser. X11 production route opens visibly and completes the fixture audit.
disposition: Reference pixel comparison, high-DPI and Windows/macOS remain; legacy console announces base actions before the bound vehicle service total. Keep this visual polish separate from the17 genuinely missing workflows.

description: There are 53 MP10 pages and 46 concrete Qt factories: 45 mapped reference routes plus QML Plugins, with the same three group headings. Eight reference routes are still absent. The previous inventory already documented eleven gaps but the runtime gate checked only our own 43 IDs. An independent manifest now enumerates all 53 reference IDs/groups and explicitly verifies the eight-gap allowlist, order, real factory content and teardown. Joystick consumes its formerly dormant profile flag and opens the shared legacy dialog; it is partial reuse, not an embedded MP10 port. FFT is now a native page with offline spectra and exact parameters; PX4Flow now has a native offline image/focus route; only the REPL flag lacks routes. Connected Serial Ports, Initial Parameters and Motor Test now match reference visibility; modern Heli retains H_SW_TYPE and Compass/Motor retains its safety lifetime. Qt restores every selected page, unlike MP10 non-sub-only persistence, so early-created shared-action pages are explicitly rebound after action registration.
disposition: Use SETUP_REFERENCE_INVENTORY.tsv and SETUP_INVENTORY_AUDIT.md as the independent baseline; port the eight missing routes as functional slices, audit connected/profile matrices and retain useful legacy modules with honest partial labels.

description: The unrelated legacy MinimOSD telemetry-rate helper is no longer exposed as CONFIG ConfigOSDView. The restored route now uses a dedicated phase-one screen/item editor with staged EN/X/Y changes, a basic draggable canvas and exact-target result-aware batch writes; unlike MP10's current per-field live writes, Write customization/Discard are retained for safer ACK-confirmed batching, and OSD 5/6 Tuning Slots is visibly disabled with its phase reason. SETUP continues to use ConfigHWOSDView.
disposition: Complete Settings/global fields, glyph-backed exact SD/HD canvases, copy/paste/clear, optional auto-write, tuning slots, profile gating and live evidence; remove obsolete OsdConfig only after no route consumes it.

description: MP10's 15 ordered CONFIG routes are encoded in ConfigRouteProfile and the truthful Qt ConfigView registers 15 real factories. A shared deterministic displayview JSON profile applies all 11 CONFIG gates, starts Advanced on a clean install, migrates QGC_MAINWINDOW/ADVANCED_MODE once, retains MP10's hidden Standard/Advanced Params startup override and synchronizes the legacy Advanced Mode action as a Basic/Advanced preset switch. Heli is excluded from Copter Basic, VTOL and boats use Plane/Rover families, and GeoFence stays Copter-only deliberately. MAVFtp is shared with SETUP, legacy Heli Setup is native, and Extended Tuning dispatches Plane to the native QP page while retaining the useful Copter/Heli editor.
disposition: Preserve the single profile owner and compose its gates with truthful vehicle/factory restrictions. Continue replacing visibly marked legacy pages only with complete native workflows and keep every supported route non-empty.

surface: Legacy Heli Setup safety and lifecycle
description: MP10 exposes H_SV_MAN modes without an armed gate or blade-removal confirmation and only stops its visualization timer on deactivation. Qt requires the exact target to be disarmed for every non-disable write, requires a default-Cancel blade-removal confirmation for modes 1..5, exposes mode 5 but disables it unless matching metadata declares the value, correlates terminal results by exact batch ID and latches uncertainty across lost ACKs/raw echoes until an exact successful zero batch. Hiding/deactivation makes a best-effort H_SV_MAN=0 write; link/target uncertainty raises a ConfigView-owned warning. On final ConfigView destruction the synchronous submission is handed to the longer-lived ParameterService before page disconnect, but a later terminal failure no longer has a UI owner. Hiding the application can therefore disable manual mode earlier than MP10.
disposition: Retain the fail-closed confirmation, exact-batch terminal correlation, idempotent Disable and conservative latch; add an application-owned exact-batch safety guard for late teardown failures, then validate the complete enable/deactivate sequence on legacy heli hardware.

description: MP10 CONFIG identifies Heli Setup only through legacy H_SWASH_TYPE. Qt also recognizes heartbeat MAV_TYPE_HELICOPTER and current H_SW_TYPE to prevent showing Copter Basic Tuning, but exposes the binary CONFIG editor only when H_SWASH_TYPE actually exists. An H_SW_TYPE-only vehicle now receives the distinct five-section SETUP Heli Setup (4.0+) page instead of an unsafe CCPM/H1 substitute. Missing enum metadata leaves the corresponding combo read-only, while numeric fallbacks use the explicit original ConfigTradHeli bounds.
disposition: Keep the two native pages separated by their exact H_SWASH_TYPE versus H_SW_TYPE capability; never alias H_SW_TYPE to H_SWASH_TYPE or H_COL_LAND_MIN to H_LAND_COL_MIN.

description: The Qt page uses three explicit S1/S2/S3 degree readouts inside a gauge-like panel instead of MP10's custom three-needle circular Gauge. The collective/acro graph, cursor, vertical collective bar, horizontal rudder bar, ranges and safety warning are present.
disposition: Replace the three readouts with a native three-needle gauge during the screenshot-driven visual parity pass; retain the current functional telemetry contract.

description: Qt uses one application-owned exact-target service for the CONFIG and SETUP pages, adds explicit Cancel, a default-Cancel replacement/partial-upload warning and atomic QSaveFile downloads with collision-avoiding names. It currently buffers each transfer up to 64 MiB, uses sequential 80-byte reads instead of MP10's optional burst path, and the local collision check is not an exclusive no-replace primitive. It does not yet gate the page on AUTOPILOT_VERSION FTP capability. Both browser and Developer use callback-safe owned operation IDs/results/progress/cancellation; this prevents old or foreign callbacks from consuming or cancelling replacement work. The older browser still captures its target after static modal file/confirmation prompts, so a selection change during consent can retarget an operation. The new Developer download pins before prompts and is not affected.
disposition: First pin the browser target and operation inputs before every file/confirmation prompt, reject any changed generation at admission, and add target-change and deletion tests. Keep exact physical-link lease/correlation, per-operation bounded retries, close/reset-before-CRC verification and shared ownership. Add streaming QIODevice transfer, exclusive no-replace local creation, burst loss recovery and capability gating before targeting large log files; retain the visible size error until then.

description: Re-enabling BackstageView automatic selection with an empty current route now synchronously selects and constructs the first visible page; ConfigView preserves a still-visible route across reset, retains constructor-time lazy selection and guards programmatic fallback from overwriting the saved preference.
disposition: Keep the shared fallback regression requiring a non-empty page ID, current widget and non-negative stack index; extend coverage with a production ConfigView vehicle/profile transition matrix when its test fixture is introduced.

description: The sole native Planner route is CONFIG and uses one application-owned ConfigPlannerViewModel with the exact nine MP10 section titles/order; the orphaned standalone action and duplicate top-level dialog have been removed. Twenty-one of 64 direct controls now have working native equivalents, including live HUD Overlay, Message Severity, Speech master/Test and eight MP10 speech event controls. Layout is explicitly separated from the unavailable MP10 Theme/Edit Custom editor, and missing dist-to-home, Track Length and safe runtime GCS-sysid controls are disclosed rather than implied working. HUD uses one canonical CHK_hudshow owner across Planner and its context menu instead of the old private FlightData/Hud key; no migration is needed in the fresh 3.0 namespace. speechenable gates TTS but deliberately does not suppress WAV alerts/beeps, and missing Qt TextToSpeech is reported visibly. Periodic Custom/Alt Warning/Low Speed/No Data plus high-priority STATUSTEXT speech use one exact physical-target telemetry epoch and the bounded shared TTS queue. Remaining members are explicitly unavailable rather than inert; the named Legacy dialog retains themes, file paths and the different seven-rate editor. The missing Test Speech audio was a build-configuration defect: the old default silently omitted TextToSpeech without its development package. Qt audio is now required by default, with an explicit silent opt-out, precise runtime diagnostics and a manual speech_backend_probe. Real speechd synthesis and a production CONFIG button click with audio-output capture pass; silent builds are not speech evidence.
disposition: Retain CONFIG as the sole canonical route, the native topology, truthful disclosures and shared owners. Port vario, speech level, language/speed, OSD colors, confirmation-safe shortcuts, five target-safe telemetry rates/identity, overlays/cache/external ADS-B and advanced policies as complete slices; remove a Legacy control only after its replacement passes lifecycle and real-X11 checks.

description: Qt persists deterministic JSON for all 11 CONFIG and 35 SETUP flags and preserves unknown Custom JSON fields; 31 SETUP flags currently have active factory consumers and four remain dormant with missing routes. It deliberately omits MP10's legacy XML, enum-caption and advancedview migrations. The default Custom file is in writable application data rather than beside the executable, and a missing/invalid Custom file leaves the active profile unchanged with a visible error rather than applying MP10's raw template fallback.
disposition: Retain the fresh-port JSON contract and one application-owned service. Add fields without dropping unknown keys, connect dormant flags only with their real routes, and do not reintroduce legacy migrations unless a real deployed profile requires them.

description: Automatic MP10 listeners are excluded from LINKMANAGER/LINKS so their enable switch works on the next launch and manual UDP definitions remain independent. Exactly one pre-policy hostless UDP 14550 is adopted and removed from the manual array once to migrate the old implicit default; a definition with outbound hosts is preserved. Editing an automatic link turns it into a persisted manual definition. Automatic listeners stop after one failed bind instead of retrying and reporting an error every 50 ms. The default alternate port 14551 can intentionally collide with the NMEA Output UDP Host default; that tool refuses the collision visibly.
disposition: Keep automatic/manual ownership separate, open each configured port independently, and require the operator to move one endpoint when Startup UDP and NMEA UDP Host would bind the same port.

description: Trusted QML plugins load with broad in-process API access and now have a user-facing Advanced inventory, enable/reload, folder access and diagnostics surface; lifecycle/reentrancy tests pass.
disposition: Continue documenting and widening the intentionally un-sandboxed API as functional packages require it.

description: Official frame defaults can be discovered, cached, compared and staged with exact-target guards and operation-scoped cancellation, but native-platform/live-network/live-vehicle evidence is incomplete.
disposition: Keep staging separate from explicit parameter write, then add integration evidence and close the remaining visual differences.

description: The MP10 hardware-ID filter, signed device-ID decoding and six-column table are implemented over the committed component snapshot; live sensor/device and native-platform evidence is incomplete.
disposition: Validate against representative CAN/I2C/SPI/UAVCAN vehicles and complete screenshot/copy-export parity.

description: ADSB_/AVD_ parameters and uAvionix flight-ID/registration messaging are implemented with exact-target guards, but live transponder and Windows/macOS evidence is incomplete and the MP10 displayADSB profile flag has no Qt equivalent yet.
disposition: Validate against uAvionix hardware, add profile-driven visibility when the vehicle profile service is ported, and retain exact link/system/component filtering.

description: SETUP activation, reply ownership, inactivity timeout, immutable device selection and uploader teardown are safe, but the page still downloads and parses the roughly 72 MB uncompressed manifest in memory and enumerates serial ports synchronously.
disposition: Adopt the compressed manifest through a bounded cross-platform streaming decompressor, cache it atomically, move parsing/enumeration off the GUI thread, and preserve the single-operation state machine.

description: The Qt page uses three compact metadata editor sections, while MP10 renders one vertically detailed item list with description text under every field.
disposition: Keep the working editor reuse for the broadly usable milestone; unify the presentation and validate screenshots during the visual-parity pass.

description: IPv4 validation deliberately accepts only canonical dotted-decimal IPv4, while .NET IPAddress.TryParse used by MP10 can also accept legacy shorthand and non-decimal forms.
disposition: Keep strict dotted-decimal input because the page and device protocol expose four explicit IPv4 octets; document the safer accepted difference instead of emulating ambiguous legacy parsing.

description: The page now composes its connected-target requirement with the shared MP10 DisplayView.displayEsp flag. The profile service is application-owned, so no page-local compatibility setting exists.
disposition: Retain the shared gate and exact-target ESP8266 transport lifecycle; validate the route against live bridge hardware.

description: The pure Qt output layer rejects non-finite angles, reversed/zero angular ranges and a missing writer, revalidates ranges before every command, stops on reentrant close and converts writer exceptions to failure; MP10 validates only zero ranges during Init and can otherwise emit an ambiguous extreme or propagate a serial exception. The factory also returns a null result for an unknown interface for the owning service to report.
disposition: Retain fail-closed validation and explicit writer results in the single-threaded cross-platform serial service, surface the exact MP10 error text to the user, and keep the accepted defensive differences covered by protocol/lifecycle tests.

description: The pure Qt geometry uses explicit finite-position validity, wraps longitude differences across the dateline and safely handles poles instead of inheriting MP10's latitude-zero sentinels and unbounded longitude delta. Its aggregate PointAt result reports plus/minus 90 degrees for a vertically coincident vehicle, while the MP-compatible ELToMAV function retains MP10's zero result at zero horizontal distance.
disposition: Retain explicit validity and safe dateline/pole behavior. The live output loop must use the documented MP-compatible AZToMAV/ELToMAV functions unless a deliberate PointAt behavior change is separately exposed to the user.

description: The Qt service uses an event-driven bounded write pipeline, keeps only the newest waiting target and fails closed on serial errors or a write-progress timeout; MP10 performs synchronous writes from its 10 Hz loop, can accumulate blocking work and swallows loop exceptions while continuing.
disposition: Retain the bounded latest-target-wins behavior, explicit failure state and port release. Surface failure/reconnect state in both tracker views and keep cancellation, partial-write, reentrancy and unplug coverage.

description: MP10 attempts all 24 stream-rate names sequentially and exposes the thrown exception text; the Qt port submits only names present in the committed exact-component snapshot as one tracked batch, disables an action that cannot write anything, and reports partial, cancellation and timeout results explicitly.
disposition: Retain the target-safe transactional behavior and missing-parameter diagnostics; verify the 24-write full path on a live vehicle and keep the exact MP10 visible control inventory.

description: Reference ordering, labels and page geometry remain incomplete. At the user's request group captions now change from >> collapsed to << expanded, with matching tooltip/accessibility state; current MP10 keeps literal >> in both states. Joystick currently uses a launcher and the useful legacy modeless editor instead of an embedded MP10 view. X11 verifies both Advanced arrow states and the actual dialog.
disposition: Preserve the requested dynamic state indication. Keep Joystick explicitly partial and defer remaining geometry polish until functional routes exist.

description: Linux build/tests are verified at the checkpoint; native Windows and macOS package/runtime evidence is still outstanding.
disposition: Keep CMake/Qt code cross-platform and add native CI/package evidence in a later release gate.

description: Automated reference screenshot-diff coverage is incomplete, so no parity ledger row is strict-complete.
disposition: Do not block broad functionality on minor pixel differences; retain them for the dedicated visual pass.

description: The vendored C ardupilotmega dialect was generated in 2022, while the MP10 reference uses a 2025 dialect; modern message IDs and changed schemas cannot be decoded by the application or Developer Tools.
disposition: Update the vendored MAVLink generator output as a dedicated repository-wide compatibility slice, then rerun all protocol, transfer, inspector and parser tests with fixed modern golden frames.

description: One shared AntennaTrackerUIViewModel owned by SetupView backs both "Antenna Tracker (Serial)" and "Antenna Tracker (Live)"; MP10 creates an independent view model per page, so two independent tracker connections were possible there. The shared instance keeps one physical tracker on one port, keeps the 10 Hz loop alive across page resets and navigation and shows the same connection state on both pages.
disposition: Retain the shared instance. If a second independent tracker is ever required, add a second view model with a mutual port-ownership check instead of duplicating the pages.

description: Home / Center keeps MP10 semantics: it resets the manual sliders and sends one PanAndTilt(0, 0) without enabling manual mode, so the next automatic tick overwrites the centre while a vehicle position is available.
disposition: Keep MP10 behavior for the usable-program milestone; revisit as a one-line change (enable manual mode from Home / Center) only if operators ask.

description: The SiK trim sweep is a cancellable timer-driven state machine that stops on disconnect and shutdown, while MP10 blocks a worker for about 68 s and cannot be cancelled. The input now matches MP10: link-scoped RADIO_STATUS/legacy RADIO raw fields, (rssi - noise) / 1.9, a 50 percent read-driven EMA and a 1 s hold; messages do not advance the filter and samples have no age expiry.
